title: scTIME: Interpretable immune-state modeling for NSCLC immunotherapy research
description: Reproducibility package for scTIME, an interpretable immune-state modeling workflow using public NSCLC single-cell, bulk transcriptomic, TCGA, and CPTAC resources. This record contains code and de-identified/publicly redistributable derived source data only; external source data must be obtained from their primary repositories.
